title: Model Question Paper 3
meta: Time: 3 hours · Maximum marks: 100 · Modelled on the April 2026 NIOS paper
instructions: All questions are compulsory. Where a question has OR, answer either one.
Section A: questions 1–20 are MCQs (1 mark each); 21–24 have two 1-mark parts; 25–28 have four 1-mark parts; 29 has six 1-mark parts.
Section B: questions 30–38 carry 2 marks, 39–43 carry 4 marks and 44–45 carry 6 marks.
Every answer shows the working. Questions from previous NIOS papers show the exam they appeared in.

questions.answer:

sections.title: Objective type questions of four 1-mark parts.

questions.q: For A(1, 2), B(4, 6) and C(7, 2), find: (a) AB; (b) the midpoint of AC; (c) the centroid of ΔABC; (d) the area of ΔABC.
A and B are 2 × 2 matrices with aᵢⱼ = i + j and bᵢⱼ = i − j. Find (i) A + 2B, (ii) AB, (iii) A', (iv) B⁻¹.

True or False: (a) Matrix A is singular if |A| ≠ 0. (b) |a+b c+d; e+f g+h| = |a c; e g| + |b d; f h|. (c) Interchanging two rows changes the sign of a determinant. (d) The determinant of a 3 × 3 skew-symmetric matrix is 0.
questions.answer:
(a) False — singular means |A| = 0.
(b) False — a determinant splits along one row (or column) at a time only.
(c) True.
(d) True — |A| = |A'| = |−A| = −|A| ⇒ |A| = 0.

questions.q: Evaluate: (i) ∫cos√x/√x dx; (ii) ∫e^(3 log x)·x⁴ dx; (iii) ∫sec²x/√(1 − tan²x) dx; (iv) ∫cosec x(cosec x + cot x)dx.
questions.answer:
(i) t = √x, dt = dx/(2√x): 2∫cos t dt = 2 sin√x + c.
(ii) e^(3 log x) = x³, so ∫x⁷dx = x⁸/8 + c.
(iii) t = tan x: ∫dt/√(1 − t²) = sin⁻¹(tan x) + c.
(iv) ∫(cosec²x + cosec x cot x)dx = −cot x − cosec x + c.

sections.title: Objective type question of six 1-mark parts.

questions.q: a = i + j + k and b = i + j. (a) a·b; (b) a unit vector ⊥ both; (c) area with a and b as diagonals; (d) verify |a × b|² = a²b² − (a·b)²; (e) |2b × a|; (f) is a × b = b × a?
questions.answer:
(a) 1 + 1 + 0 = 2.
(b) a × b = |i j k; 1 1 1; 1 1 0| = −i + j + 0k; unit vector (−i + j)/√2.
(c) ½|a × b| = ½√2 = √2/2.
(d) |a × b|² = 2; a²b² − (a·b)² = 3·2 − 4 = 2. Verified.
(e) |2b × a| = 2|a × b| = 2√2.
(f) No — they are opposite vectors.

questions.q: For what values of x and y are [[2x + 1, 3y], [0, y² − 5y]] and [[x + 3, y² + 2], [0, −6]] equal?
questions.answer:
2x + 1 = x + 3 ⇒ x = 2.
3y = y² + 2 ⇒ y² − 3y + 2 = 0 ⇒ y = 1 or 2.
y² − 5y = −6 ⇒ y² − 5y + 6 = 0 ⇒ y = 2 or 3.
Common value: y = 2. So x = 2, y = 2.

questions.q: Without expanding, prove that |0 a −b; −a 0 −c; b c 0| = 0.
questions.answer:
Let Δ be the determinant. Its transpose has every element negated (it is skew-symmetric), so Δ = |A'| = |−A| = (−1)³Δ = −Δ.
Hence 2Δ = 0 ⇒ Δ = 0.

questions.q: Using elementary row operations, find the inverse of A = [[3, 5], [4, 7]].
Show that the signum function f(x) = 1 (x > 0), 0 (x = 0), −1 (x < 0) on R is neither one-one nor onto.
questions.answer:
f(1) = f(2) = 1, so it is not one-one.
Its range is {−1, 0, 1}; for example 2 has no pre-image, so it is not onto.

questions.q: Simplify tan[sin⁻¹√(1 − x)].
questions.answer:
Let sin θ = √(1 − x). Then cos θ = √(1 − (1 − x)) = √x.
tan θ = √(1 − x)/√x = √((1 − x)/x).

questions.q: Find lim x→π (1 + cos x)/tan²x.
questions.answer:
tan²x = sin²x/cos²x = (1 − cos x)(1 + cos x)/cos²x.
(1 + cos x)cos²x/[(1 − cos x)(1 + cos x)] = cos²x/(1 − cos x) → 1/(1 + 1) = ½.

questions.q: If x³ + y³ = 3axy, find dy/dx.
questions.answer:
3x² + 3y² dy/dx = 3a(y + x dy/dx).
dy/dx(y² − ax) = ay − x² ⇒ dy/dx = (ay − x²)/(y² − ax).

questions.q: If cos y = x cos(a + y), prove that dy/dx = cos²(a + y)/sin a.
questions.answer:
x = cos y/cos(a + y). dx/dy = [−sin y cos(a + y) + cos y sin(a + y)]/cos²(a + y) = sin(a + y − y)/cos²(a + y) = sin a/cos²(a + y).
So dy/dx = cos²(a + y)/sin a.

questions.q: If y = eˣ/x, find dy/dx.
For the ellipse 3x² + 2y² = 6 find the lengths of the axes, the foci, the vertices and the eccentricity.
questions.answer:
x²/2 + y²/3 = 1: major axis along y, a² = 3, b² = 2.
Major axis 2√3, minor axis 2√2.
c² = 3 − 2 = 1 ⇒ foci (0, ±1); vertices (0, ±√3); e = c/a = 1/√3.

questions.q: Prove that tan⁻¹(1/7) + tan⁻¹(1/13) = tan⁻¹(2/9).
If y = sin⁻¹x, show that (1 − x²) d²y/dx² − x dy/dx = 0.
questions.answer:
dy/dx = 1/√(1 − x²) ⇒ √(1 − x²) y' = 1.
Differentiate: √(1 − x²) y'' + y'(−x/√(1 − x²)) = 0.
Multiply by √(1 − x²): (1 − x²)y'' − xy' = 0.

or.q: Find the area of the smaller region bounded by x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 and x/a + y/b = 1.
or.answer:
Quarter ellipse area = πab/4. Triangle under the line from (a, 0) to (0, b) has area ab/2.
Smaller region = πab/4 − ab/2 = (π − 2)ab/4.
